children: Shares of Chinese artificial intelligence chipmaker Shanghai Enflame Technology (688801.SS) are set to open 188% higher at 410 yuan in their Shanghai debut on Friday.
The Tencent-backed company raised 6.12 billion yuan ($912 million) in its initial public offering earlier this month.
